description: gleam_rules.ml detect_use_candidates (line 1285) handles empty arg lists with 'try List.hd (List.rev args) with Failure _ -> {fabricated EUnit node with fake zeroed location}'. Catching an exception to produce a sentinel node is fragile and hides bugs. Replace with an explicit pattern match on args (function [] -> ... | _ -> last element) or an option-returning helper. Pure readability/robustness change, no behavior shift.
title: detect_use_candidates: replace sentinel-expr exception hack
